canDoYue: 你識問場合同設計偏好，仲識用假如講訂金同跟進。
canDoEn: Ask about the occasion and the design preference, then use if and would for a deposit and a follow-up.

dialogue.speaker: ada
dialogue.text: Good morning. I was wondering whether this special occasion is an anniversary or a quiet engagement this month.
dialogue.glossYue: 早晨。我想問呢個特別場合係週年，定係低調慶祝訂婚。
dialogue.say: Good morning. I was wondering whether this special occasion is an anniversary or a quiet engagement this month.

dialogue.speaker: nia
dialogue.text: The occasion is an anniversary dinner, and my preference is a custom design with a classic gold look.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢個場合係週年晚飯，我偏好係經典金款嘅訂做設計。
dialogue.say: The occasion is an anniversary dinner, and my preference is a custom design with a classic gold look.

dialogue.speaker: ada
dialogue.text: If you chose a contemporary gold piece, would you like it understated or more of a bold statement?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果你揀一件現代金飾，你想要低調，定係搶眼啲？
dialogue.say: If you chose a contemporary gold piece, would you like it understated or more of a bold statement?

dialogue.speaker: nia
dialogue.text: My clear preference is understated, and I would treat this special gold piece as a quiet personal investment.
dialogue.glossYue: 我明顯偏好低調，我會當呢件特別金飾係一份私人保值。
dialogue.say: My clear preference is understated, and I would treat this special gold piece as a quiet personal investment.

dialogue.speaker: nia
dialogue.text: If I placed a custom deposit today, would the full timeline still fit my anniversary appointment next month?
dialogue.glossYue: 如果我今日落訂金，成個時間表仲趕唔趕得切我下個月嘅週年預約？
dialogue.say: If I placed a custom deposit today, would the full timeline still fit my anniversary appointment next month?

dialogue.speaker: ada
dialogue.text: I was wondering whether you also value availability, exclusivity, and a discreet follow-up call after the appointment.
dialogue.glossYue: 我想問你重唔重視檔期、獨家，同預約之後一次低調嘅跟進電話。
dialogue.say: I was wondering whether you also value availability, exclusivity, and a discreet follow-up call after the appointment.

dialogue.speaker: nia
dialogue.text: If the new design were more contemporary, I would still want a discreet and understated gold investment piece.
dialogue.glossYue: 如果新設計再現代啲，我都想要一件低調又含蓄嘅金保值。
dialogue.say: If the new design were more contemporary, I would still want a discreet and understated gold investment piece.

dialogue.speaker: ada
dialogue.text: If you confirmed the deposit, I would book a follow-up and protect the exclusivity of the design.
dialogue.glossYue: 如果你確認訂金，我會約跟進，並保住呢個設計嘅獨家。
dialogue.say: If you confirmed the deposit, I would book a follow-up and protect the exclusivity of the design.
